```{python}
print("\nPART 2")
with open("odyssey.txt", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    text = f.read()
words = text.split()
print(len(words))
print(words[0:20])
print(words[149:158])

unique_words = set(words)
print(len(unique_words))

ttr = len(unique_words) / len(words)
print(ttr)
print("The TTR for the Odyssey is lower than for the other texts. It is likely that TTR decreases as the length of a text increases as certain grammatical structures and common words are used much more often the more is written in total.")

print("Odysseus count: ", text.count("Odysseus"))
position = text.find("Odysseus")
print(text[position - 150 : position + 150])

"Ulysses" in text
print("Ulysses count: ", text.count("Ulysses"))


character_counts = {
    "Ulysses": text.count("Ulysses"),
    "Penelope": text.count("Penelope"),
    "Telemachus": text.count("Telemachus"),
    "Minerva": text.count("Minerva")
}
print(character_counts)
print("The name Ulysses occurs the most often in the text of the Odyssey.")

character_counts.update({"Achilles": text.count("Achilles")})
print(character_counts)
```
